easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Stunt Double.
description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Stunt Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Stunt Double. Choose to have Stunt Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.
